draft.subject: Getting Blue Labs' first project going
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

Thanks for flagging the notification badge last week — glad that one's resolved; let me know if the badge count reappears.

Since our onboarding call, I wanted to check in on getting a real project set up. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so that first one tends to make the rest click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if you'd like to start there.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to work through your first project together and answer anything that's come up.

Best,
Chidi
